name: Data quality
description: Find missing labels and source references. Keep a dated report of what needs attention.

checks.name: Missing labels
checks.description: Typed resources without a non-empty Schema.org name, RDFS label or SKOS preferred label.
checks.where: ?entity a ?type. FILTER(isIRI(?entity)) FILTER NOT EXISTS {?entity (schema:name|rdfs:label|skos:prefLabel) ?label. FILTER(STRLEN(STR(?label)) > 0)}

checks.name: Missing source references
checks.description: Named, typed resources without a direct citation, source or provenance reference. Statement-level evidence may still exist.
